source.excerpt: Shared as an editor that decides the treatment before it starts cutting.

body:
## What it does

It diagnoses the treatment first and then works the clips, cuts, sound, titles and pacing, so what comes back is a cut you review rather than a pile of trimmed files. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @XFreeze shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
